hypotheses.statement: There is no bond between the endpoints.
Let $(w_i)$ be a finite or countable probability list, and suppose its purity is at least $1-u$, where $0\le u<1$.
Suppose that $n\ge4$ is even, $b>0$, and $S(n,b)\ge s$, $T(2n,b)\ge t$, with $0<s,t\le1$.
Let $\lambda_0$ be the positive leading eigenvalue of $X_{b_0}$, and let $c_0$ be the squared norm of the projection of $v_{b_0}$ onto its eigenspace.
Let $E_0^{\mathrm{opp}}(m)$ be the smallest eigenvalue of $H_m^{\mathrm{opp}}$.

evidence.quote: Periodic concentration therefore leaves a boundary-overlap problem.
We solve it by contracting the residual boundary-weighted moments while tracking the physical Gibbs purity (the sum of the squared Gibbs probabilities) of the opposite-field chain.
The particular spatial transfer operator and finite periodic estimates used here come from (OpenAI 2026) [[periodic](#ref-periodic)], which proves a uniform gap on even periodic rings.

Suppose $j\ge2$, $0\le E_j,\eta_j<1$, and $$e_{k_j}(j)\le E_j,\qquad A(M_j,j)\ge1-\eta_j.$$ Let $E_{j+1},\eta_{j+1}\in[0,1)$ satisfy $$\begin{aligned}
 E_{j+1}&\ge
 F\left(d(u_{j+1})^{(M_j-k_j)/M_j},E_j,1-\eta_j\right),
                                                   \label{be:Eupdate}\\
 \eta_{j+1}&\ge f\left(1-(1-\eta_j)(1-u_j)(1-u_{j+1})
                                      (1-E_{j+1})\right).
                                                   \label{be:etaupdate}
\end{aligned}$$ Then $e_{k_{j+1}}(j+1)\le E_{j+1}$ and $A(M_{j+1},j+1)\ge1-\eta_{j+1}$.

For $j\ge0$, an even $M\ge2$, and any integer $n\ge M$, define $Q_j(n)=Y_n^{\rm s}(b_j)/\lambda_j^n$. Then $$\label{co:error}
 |Q_j(n)-c_j|\le B_M(j)-c_j.$$

For $j\ge5$ and every integer $n$ with $M_j\le n\le2M_j$, $$\label{co:purity-bound}
 \frac{Y_n^{\rm s}(b_{j+1})}{Y_n^{\rm s}(b_j)^2}\ge1-4x_j.$$

Every boundary-selected state [top:limit] is invariant under uniform rotations about the $z$ axis and under reflection $j\mapsto-j$. With $\gamma_*=(\log10)/392$, it satisfies $$\label{top:local-gap} \omega\bigl(A^*[H_{\rm bulk},A]\bigr) \ge\gamma_*\bigl(\omega(A^*A)-|\omega(A)|^2\bigr) \qquad\text{for every local }A.$$ In particular it is a locally-unique gapped ground state in the sense of (Tasaki 2025, Definition 11) [[Tasaki2025](#ref-Tasaki2025)], and its Tasaki index is $-1$.
For every pair $(n,g)$ in [appth:integer-table], $$\left\|\widehat E-\exp[-b_0(H_{n,g}+C_nI)/2]\right\|_{\rm F} <2\cdot10^{-10}.$$
